title: Autopsy and Confession Anew
author: Astrid Ishikawa
blurb: Marguerite Crane, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
